sources.title: Michigan Bridge Design Standards and Guides, MDOT Bridge Week, March 17-19 2026 (60 slides)
sources.contents: Overview of MDOT BDM, Bridge Design Guides, Special Details, Standard Plans; galvanic anodes; PC beam lifting stability (slides 51-53 list BDG 6.65.14 and Special Details PC-1Q, PC-2L, PC-4J, PC-5D; slide 52 is an elevation of lifting loops only). Slide 8 shows BDG 8.43.01 (issued 02/24/25) with sole-plate lengths: Type I 1'-4", Type II 1'-6", Type III 1'-10", Type IV and 70" I-beam 2'-2", Michigan 1800 2'-11 3/8", Bulb Tee 3'-4". No beam section, dimension table or property table anywhere (all 60 slides viewed on a contact sheet; slides 8, 26, 52 viewed at 150-300 dpi).
sources.outcome: Nothing implemented. MI 1800 remains a lead: only its bearing sole-plate length (2'-11 3/8" ~ bottom-flange width, consistent with 900 mm) is shown. Lead: BDG 6.60.03 / Special Detail PC-4 series (not in hand).

sources.title: Punjab Communication and Works Department, Standard Specifications for Road & Bridge Construction 2022 (512 pp)
sources.contents: Text-only construction specification. pdftotext grep: 'girder' 52 hits (placement, curing, erection, formwork clauses e.g. text lines ~13673-13721, 15437-17012), 'precast' 48 (members, piles, posts, paving blocks), 'prestressed' 14, 'AASHTO' 350 (material/test standards), 'Type I/II/III' only for cement types, 'I-girder'/'box beam'/'Type IV' 0. Only two large raster images (PDF p3 cover, p245 bituminous paving record form).
sources.outcome: No girder sections specified or dimensioned. Nothing implemented; existing pk NHA Types A-H unaffected.

sources.title: Ministry of Works and Development, Standard Bridge Design - Standard Steel Truss Deck Systems, Two lane through type truss, design report alternatives 1a, 1b, 1c & 2 (drawing X261/0/112/17/6004 sheet 1)
sources.contents: Scanned 1-bit drawing (299 dpi). Alternative 2 'Stahlton longspan deck, transoms 4 m crs': pairs of 230 mm deep Stahlton planks at 963 mm crs, 25 mm treated timber permanent formwork, 125 mm concrete deck, 762x267x173 UB transoms at 4.000 crs, 150x90x12 L seating. Plank shown schematically as narrow inverted-trapezoid webs; no width, web or flange dimension.
sources.outcome: Not implemented: only depth (230 mm) and pair spacing (963 mm) are given; no defensible outline. Lead: Stahlton Longspan plank product data.
